items.title: Creating Inclusive Applications for Diverse Users

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Creating Inclusive Applications for Diverse Users under 9.3 as printed (PDF 130, printed 126).

blocks.text: Inclusive applications are designed to meet the needs of different types of users. This can include adding features such as screen readers for the visually impaired, subtitles for videos, or multiple language options. Simple layouts and clear text also make apps easier to use for beginners. Developers should test their designs with a variety of users to ensure accessibility for all. Creating inclusive digital tools supports equality and improves the overall user experience.
